user.title: Claude Code Assist
user.description: Connect to the Claude Code Assist app. Leave the token empty to read it automatically from the app.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Claude Code Assist app. Is it installed and running?
error.no_token: No token found. Start the Claude Code Assist app first.

run_task.name: Run task
run_task.description: Give Claude Code a task from an automation or script. It runs in the shared conversation; the result is fired as event claude_code_assist_task_finished and, with wait on, returned as response.

prompt.name: Task
prompt.description: What Claude Code should do. No one reads the reply unless the task says how to report (for example a notification).

run_id.name: Run ID
run_id.description: Name of this run, used in the events and the task list. Generated if empty.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model for the work, for example opus. Claude Code uses an agent with this model. Empty: the app's model.

wait.name: Wait for the result
wait.description: Wait until the task is finished and return the result as response (use response_variable).

timeout.name: Maximum wait
timeout.description: How long to wait for the result when waiting.
